description: Source code for a 'git bugreport' command implementation, including functions for gathering system info, hooks, and generating a bug report file.

methods.name: get_system_info
methods.description: Collects system information such as git version, uname, compiler, libc, and shell environment.

methods.name: get_populated_hooks
methods.description: Retrieves and lists enabled hooks if in a git repository.

methods.name: get_bug_template
methods.description: Provides a template for the bug report content.

methods.name: get_header
methods.description: Adds a header with a title to the report buffer.

methods.name: cmd_bugreport
methods.description: Main function to generate a bug report, handle options, create diagnostics, and open editor.
